text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — AstraHealth asked for an on‑prem/private deploy target plus canary + KMS integration and per-tenant billing by end of Q3. Rafael, can we commit to dates?
Rafael Ortiz: Looping in Sasha and Kyle. They also want dedicated capacity and regional routing. Customer is pressing on timelines.
Sasha Patel: We can deliver a minimal private package (VPC + KMS integration using cloud KMS) in ~8 weeks if we constrain scope: no HSM, no air-gapped installer for pilot. Canary rollout is fine with current control plane.
Kyle O'Neill: They also asked for token-level cost reports in Console and basic RBAC for pilot users — those are product UI/backfill items.
Maya Chen: We need to align to roadmap / OKRs. This maps to OKR: "Private deployments — 3 marquee pilots". If eng can do 8 weeks, that's still Q3.
Rafael Ortiz: AstraHealth indicated they'd convert to a 12‑month Dedicated contract if pilot delivered on timeline. That's high signal.
Sasha Patel: Two engineering risks to call out: (1) packaging differences for customer network topologies (air-gapped vs VPC peering) and (2) KMS variance across cloud providers (key formats, rotation). We'll need a security pairing.
Jordan Rivera: Customer has a compliance audit mid-September and asked for a pilot by 2024-09-15. That's their ask date.
Maya Chen: 2024-09-15 pilot is aggressive. Proposal: narrow pilot scope to A) VPC + cloud KMS + canary + basic logs (pilot) and defer B) HSM, advanced RBAC, and full billing UI to Phase 2.
Sasha Patel: Agree. For canary we can reuse rollout config — example below for ops team to review:
```
rollout_policy: {
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "duration_days": 3,
  "monitoring": ["latency_p50","error_rate"],
  "fallback_model": "small-compat"
}
```
Kyle O'Neill: Product will own the RBAC and billing UI work. Can we target RBAC/billing for Q4 so pilot isn't blocked?
Maya Chen: Yes — commit to Pilot (Scope A) by 2024-09-15; Phase 2 (HSM, RBAC, billing) target 2024-11-30. We'll treat Phase 2 as prioritized partner deliverable but not blocking the pilot sign-off.
Rafael Ortiz: I'll update the SOW with those dates and push for an LOE commitment from the customer for a pilot window.
Sasha Patel: I'll open two PRDs: private-deploy-min and private-deploy-phase2 and add engineering checkpoints. Also request security review for KMS approach.
prod-bot: Created tickets RINF-1423 (private-deploy-min) and RINF-1424 (private-deploy-phase2).
Maya Chen: Nice. Please ack and post any blockers by EOD so we can finalize the roadmap slot. :thumbsup:
